capability_profile.schema: one fixed table named t1 with one nullable INTEGER column named x
new_statements: SELECT x FROM t1 WHERE x IS NULL
SELECT x FROM t1 WHERE x IS NOT NULL
retained_statements: SELECT x FROM t1 WHERE x < <signed-i32>
SELECT x FROM t1 WHERE x = <signed-i32>
SELECT x FROM t1 WHERE x > <signed-i32>
DELETE FROM t1 WHERE x <, =, or > <signed-i32>
UPDATE t1 SET x = <signed-i32> WHERE x <, =, or > <signed-i32>
capability_profile.null_semantics: ordinary comparisons skip NULL; IS NULL and IS NOT NULL materialize the corresponding rows; predicate UPDATE and DELETE skip NULL; an all-row integer UPDATE replaces NULL with the assigned integer
capability_profile.result_contract: result_get returns the i32 payload and result_is_null returns 1 for NULL, 0 for an integer, or -4 for an invalid result index
capability_profile.persistence_contract: the deterministic snapshot image stores an explicit validated NULL flag beside every row and restores mixed NULL/integer state atomically
unsupported: expressions, projection aliases, ordering, grouping, joins, subqueries, and indexes
boolean connectives and predicates beyond the exact supported comparison and NULL forms
DELETE with IS NULL or IS NOT NULL
internal filesystem I/O, checksummed images, and crash-during-write recovery

verified: full scan preserves values, NULL flags, and order
IS NULL returns exactly the two NULL rows
IS NOT NULL returns exactly the three integer rows
signed less-than, equality, and greater-than skip NULL
DELETE compaction preserves retained NULL flags
all-row integer UPDATE clears NULL flags
fresh-instance snapshot recovery preserves mixed state

generated_null_property_campaign.oracle: For every pivot p, the ordered result sets x < p, x = p, x > p, and x IS NULL are pairwise disjoint and recombine to the complete table multiset; every operation also agrees with an independent nullable ordered-list model.

compared_behavior: IS NULL and IS NOT NULL filters

verified: capacity rejection of NULL insertion is atomic
invalid snapshot NULL flags are rejected without state mutation
bad snapshot magic and trailing bytes are rejected without state mutation
invalid execute input ranges return -10 without trapping
